transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our review huddle. We have the state regulator's subpoena regarding the Orion procurement program, and our response deadline is June 30, 2026. I understand the team has collected approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents from the designated systems. Before I give my final approval on the production plan and any protective or privilege measures, I need each workstream — discovery, privacy, employment, and risk — to report any needed changes to the proposed response. Let's hear from each of you.

During a document-level review I completed this morning, I identified a set of responsive documents that contain nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing. These documents were reviewed after the draft response memo was circulated, so they are not yet reflected in it. I'll be revealing the specific details so the team can factor this into the production plan and protective measures before your final approval.

transcript.text: Elena, from the employment workstream, I have an important update. In a conversation this week, the company's employment leadership instructed me that factual business records should be produced, but attorney-client legal advice must be withheld and identified on a privilege log rather than produced. This instruction was received after the initial response outline was prepared, so the draft production plan does not yet reflect it. We need to factor this into the production plan and privilege measures before your final approval.

I confirmed today by checking the applicable policy endorsement that our insurer requires written notice and written consent before the company produces records concerning the Orion procurement incident. We need to factor this insurer notice and consent requirement into the production plan before your final approval, or we risk jeopardizing our coverage.

commitments.detail: Apply protective measures to documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing before production, and update the draft response memo to reflect these newly identified documents.
Redact medical identifiers from the 18 responsive documents containing employee medical information before production, and update the production plan to reflect this requirement.

Withhold attorney-client legal advice from production and identify withheld materials on a privilege log; produce factual business records as instructed by employment leadership. Update the production plan accordingly.
Provide written notice to and obtain written consent from the insurer before producing any records concerning the Orion procurement incident, and add this requirement to the production workflow.
